subject: general
question: What is the primary objective of the 9th Swachh Survekshan Toolkit and Super Swachh League launched by Union Minister Manohar Lal?

options.text: Enhance urban cleanliness and innovation among ULBs
Introduce competitions for rural community development

solution:
The correct answer is __**Enhance urban cleanliness and innovation among ULBs.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Housing and Urban Affairs Minister Manohar Lal launched the toolkit for the 9th Swachh Survekshan and introduced the Super Swachh League for the cleanest city competitions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aims to promote urban cleanliness through competition among cities.**
 
• Encourages continuous innovation among Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).
 
• Introduces simplified evaluation parameters for better data accuracy and transparency.
 
• Focuses on improving the reputation of Swachh Bharat initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Swachh Survekshan__

 __
 
• An annual cleanliness survey under the Swachh Bharat Mission to rank cities on sanitation performance.
 
 
 
• Super Swachh League__
 __
 
• A competition to encourage cities to achieve higher standards of cleanliness.
 
 
 
• Urban Local Bodies (ULBs)__
 
 
• Local government institutions responsible for urban planning, sanitation, and community services.
